chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever fulfills what Allah has made obligatory upon him is the most generous of people."

key_terms.أَسْخَى: most generous and most liberal in giving
key_terms.افْتَرَضَ: made obligatory and prescribed as a duty
key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One who imposes the obligations
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of the hadith

ai.seo_question: Who is considered the most generous person in this hadith of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true generosity begins with fulfilling the obligations Allah has imposed. It defines noble character not merely by voluntary giving, but by faithful obedience in what is divinely required.
